info.name: Get Point of Interests Boundary by Location.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude around which POI Boundary is requested

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude around which POI Boundary is requested

params.name: categoryCode
params.description: Specific Category/Categories Codes for the desired POIs. Accepts a mix of 4 digit (Top Category), 6 digit (Second-Level Category) and 11 digit (Low-Level Category) Category Codes

params.name: sicCode
params.description: Specify starting digits or full sic code to filter the response

params.name: naicsCode
params.description: Will accept naicsCode to filter POIs in results. Max 10 allowed.

params.name: point
params.description: Starting point from where the travel boundary is calculated. Point in Lat,Long,coordsys format

params.name: address
params.description: Starting address from where the travel boundary is calculated.

params.name: costs
params.description: Travel time used to calculate the travel boundary.

params.name: costUnit
params.description: Travel time unit such as min(Minute), h(Hour), s(Second) or msec(Millisecond).

params.name: db
params.description: Mode of commute.

params.name: country
params.description: 3 character ISO code or country name.

params.name: maxOffroadDistance
params.description: Maximum distance to allow travel off the road network.

params.name: maxOffroadDistanceUnit
params.description: MaxOffroad Distance Unit such as ft(Foot), km(Kilometer), mi(Mile), m(Meter) or yd(Yard).

params.name: destinationSrs
params.description: Desired coordinate system of the travel boundary.

params.name: majorRoads
params.description: Whether to include all roads in the calculation or just major roads.

params.name: returnHoles
params.description: Whether to return holes, which are areas within the larger boundary that cannot be reached within the desired time

params.name: returnIslands
params.description: Whether to return islands, which are small areas outside the main boundary that can be reached within the desired time

params.name: simplificationFactor
params.description: Number between 0.0 and 1.0 where 0.0 is very simple and 1.0 means the most complex

params.name: bandingStyle
params.description: Style of banding to be used in the result

params.name: historicTrafficTimeBucket
params.description: Whether routing calculation uses the historic traffic speeds

params.name: defaultAmbientSpeed
params.description: The speed to travel when going off a network road to find the travel boundary (for all road types).

params.name: ambientSpeedUnit
params.description: The unit of measure to use to calculate the ambient speed.

items.docs: Returns the travel boundary based on travel distance.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude around which Basic Boundary is requested

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude around which Basic Boundary is requested

params.name: distance
params.description: This is width of the buffer (in a complete circular buffer, it would be radius of the buffer). This has to be a positive number.

params.name: resolution
params.description: This is resolution of the buffer. Curves generated in buffer are approximated by line segments and it is measured in segments per circle. The higher the resolution, the smoother the curves of the buffer but more points would be required in the boundary geometry. Number greater than 0 and in multiple of 4. If not in 4, then it is approximated to nearest multiple of 4.
